description: This file defines the 'Setting' controller class within the Opencart admin startup namespace. It handles the initialization process by loading settings from the database, processing serialized values, and setting the PHP timezone.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class responsible for loading and applying store settings during startup in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads settings from the database, applies them to configuration, and sets the PHP timezone accordingly.
